quality.ambiguous_labels: quarantine ALL members of any saved byte-identical group with different original_class
quality.same_class_duplicates: retain lexical smallest video_id; exclude remaining copies
quality.known_duplicates: historical saved SHA-identical list only; near-duplicates unresolved

split.coverage: all eight classes in every candidate split
split.ranking: SHA256(namespace:seed:trial:source_group), then source_group; quotas assigned in train/validation/test order
split.tie_break: objective as exact Fraction, canonical assignment SHA256, then trial index
split.source_group: frozen source_group; v160/v166 merged; not independently verified real game IDs

evaluation.primary: eight-class top1; same top1 mapped to Make/Miss

activation: No current loader or trainer reads this candidate; creating metadata does not authorize training
